reviewed_surface: fly mpg destroy CLUSTER_ID (aliases delete, remove, rm; exactly one operand; -y/--yes skips the confirmation) permanently destroys a Managed Postgres cluster and all its data. The unmanaged `fly postgres` (`fly pg`) group registers no destroy command, so `fly postgres destroy` is rejected as an unknown command. -h/--help exits without acting.

addons:destroy ADDON... (hidden alias addons:remove) permanently destroys each named add-on; destroying a heroku-postgresql or heroku-redis add-on (named by its service, optionally with a :plan) deletes its database. Other add-on names stay unmodeled. pg:backups:delete BACKUP_ID deletes that Heroku Postgres backup, a recovery copy of the database.
Without a ref operand, projects delete and branches delete ask which project or branch to delete, and delete it.
